message.content:
Here’s the exact request you’d send to VirusTotal to retrieve only the related object IDs (and any context attributes) for subdomains of `example.org`, limited to 10 results and using the cursor `abc`:

```http
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/example.org/related
    ?relationship_type=subdomains
    &limit=10
    &cursor=abc
    &fields=id,context_attributes
X-Apikey: my_api
```

**Explanation of parameters**

| Parameter | Value | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `relationship_type` | `subdomains` | Filters the related objects to only those that are subdomains of the target domain. |
| `limit` | `10` | Returns at most 10 related objects per page. |
| `cursor` | `abc` | Continues from the specified pagination cursor. |
| `fields` | `id,context_attributes` | Requests only the `id` field and any `context_attributes` for each related object, omitting all other data. |

**What you’ll receive**

The response will contain an array of related objects, each with:

```json
{
  "id": "<object_id>",
  "context_attributes": { /* optional additional context */ }
}
```

No other attributes will be included, keeping the payload minimal.
